title: Shortest Paths with Arbitrary Clearance from Navigation Meshes
venue: Eurographics/ACM SIGGRAPH Symposium on Computer Animation 2010
scope: Triangulated domains and adjacent-triangle channels only. The Outshine experiment uses an already actor-eroded free space, bounded midpoint channels and containment-checked greedy shortcuts; it does not implement Local Clearance Triangulations, extended funnel search or global shortest-path guarantees.
